messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — HIGH latency SLO burn detected for inference-service-eu (p99=1.35s, threshold=0.9s). Alert: 57% p99 increase in the last 5m. Page: eng-oncall :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Pinging dashboard and logs. @pagerduty-bot please suppress duplicates for 5m :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident 24789 created. Current responders: maria (acknowledged).

samir (sre): i'm seeing a sudden spike from client-tenant batch spikes — queue depth up from 120->800 on eu-west replicas. Latency correlates with kvcache evictions.

jordan (infra): any deployments or autoscaler events in the last 10m?

maria (oncall): no user-facing deploys. Autoscaler scale-up triggered earlier but couldn't keep up. config = autoscaler:v2 (min=4,max=16)

samir (sre): running quick diagnostic:
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference-service -c sidecar --since=10m | grep "evict" | tail -n 20
2026-03-15T21:10:01Z eviction: kv_cache evicted key=tenant-42 size=512MB
2026-03-15T21:12:02Z eviction: kv_cache evicted key=tenant-17 size=320MB
```

samir (sre): Looks like hot-tenant caused repeated full-kv evictions. p99 spike aligns with those timestamps.

maria (oncall): can we quick-apply a mitigation? Options: 1) increase kv_cache size on eu nodes, 2) route tenant-42 to a dedicated pool, 3) throttle incoming batch-sized requests via sidecar.

jordan (infra): increasing kv_cache requires rolling restart of sidecar on eu nodes — might be ~6-8 min. Routing tenant is faster if we can patch routing table temporarily.

samir (sre): I can push a sidecar rate-limit rule to block very large batches from tenant-42 for 10m. Patch ready: add header check + throttle to 4 concurrent batches.

maria (oncall): do it. Also put a short manual scale-up to 12 nodes while we watch. @lia I'll hand off if this stays noisy past 30m.

samir (sre): patch applied: 4 concurrent batch limit for tenant-42. Confirming via logs...

samir (sre): patch verified — sidecar returning 429 for oversized batches from tenant-42. Queue depth down 65% within 90s.

maria (oncall): nice. Kicking manual scale-up now.

jordan (infra): scale-up done: replicas -> 12. No restarts, rolling adds.

maria (oncall): p95 dropped from 680ms->320ms, p99 from 1350ms->780ms in the last 2m. Still watching for any regressions. Adding a note to the incident.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 24789 escalated to level2 (samir) due to ongoing SLO risk.

maria (oncall): Samir, can you follow up with an RCA card? I'll stay on monitoring for another 20m then hand off to @lia for overnight watch if stable.

samir (sre): will create RCA draft and send in #postmortems. Preliminary hypothesis: hot-tenant + insufficient kv cache sizing under bursty batch traffic; mitigation = tenant throttling + scale + kvcache tuning.

lia (night-shift): acknowledged. If we see p99 > 900ms again, please page me immediately. I'll be in at 23:00.

maria (oncall): thanks team. Marking incident as 'mitigated' — will update PagerDuty when we're in steady state :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident 24789 status: mitigated. Monitoring for 30m before auto-resolve.

maria (oncall): Adding follow-ups: (1) temporary tenant routing plan, (2) permanent kvcache config change, (3) add evals for high-batch tenants. I'll file tickets now.

samir (sre): tickets created: INF-4321 (kvcache tuning), INF-4322 (tenant routing), INF-4323 (add perf test for large-batch patterns).

maria (oncall): closing thread here. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :heart:
